QUOTE: "Library threads:** none. The index found four spawn sites, all in `programs/`" and "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out ... So `threading.c` compiles to nothing useful"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library has no threads of its own by default, but it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main under that condition. It lists `ssl_pthread_server.c` as a spawn site with per-connection pthreads, which points the other way.
